## Summary
Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Changes
Describe behavior, configuration, documentation, or API changes.

## Validation
List commands actually run and their results. Mark anything not run explicitly.
Do not claim an agent/provider integration was tested without a reproducible session.

## Impact and risks
State compatibility, security, migration, and rollback considerations.

## Release impact
State the proposed bump and the authoritative engine. Preserve breaking-change footers
in the final squash message. A preview is not permission to publish.

## Related issues
Link only issues actually addressed. Use closing keywords deliberately.
